notes: SPOTLIGHT SOLO v2 SOLO FACE: the GlanceFace crop re-lit from straight above (48x26 canvas and registration of GlanceFace: a crop of src/art/hero_no10.png at (26,8); studio project "Sochetra Face", palette = the face letters, h = #ffffff). The fringe throws a jagged shadow band over the eyes; inside it each eye is a dark pit with exactly ONE white pupil pixel: pupilL / pupilR (eyeGlow and the stage-light cross glints sit here); eyeL / eyeR = the eye centres, eye = their midpoint, head = the crown point. SF2 = the glare (brows down 1 px, lids to 2 px slits; only the eyes and mouth change, the same grid as SF1). pelvis = the crop centre (23.5,12.5), contact null; draw at integer x8 on the centre. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5). Shot 1: SF1 0.06-0.60, SF2 0.60-1.45 (x8, the cut-in panel in the drop-beam pool). Fallback if missing: GlanceFace G1 with a code shadow band. Studio: Sochetra Face / SoloFace / Front, layer Art (Side/Back blank).
